title: Dependency declared with a date-shaped version
description: package.json declares a date-shaped version, which carries no compatibility signal. A calendar version cannot tell the resolver whether two releases are compatible, so a rollback or upgrade cannot be reasoned about from the manifest.
remediation: Depend on a semantic version and record the release date in the changelog.
limitation: It matches a date-shaped version, which carries no compatibility signal in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
